# Kan aktie-bulldozeren fortsat tromle gennem høje renter, svingende oliepriser og politisk uro?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor) with Michael Friis Jørgensen (H.C. Andersen Capital) and Andreas Steno (Steno Research) on how oil prices and interest rates affect equities. The panel thinks the Hormuz oil crisis is largely priced in and that the US has effectively won the fight over the strait. They see rates, credit spreads and a flattening yield curve as the bigger risk to rate-sensitive sectors. Both prefer US AI and tech, where earnings are delivered now: Steno favours memory chips (Micron, Sandisk) over Nvidia and AMD, while Friis Jørgensen leans towards Mag7. Neither is keen on Danish or European equities, and tanker shipping (Norden, Torm) is booming.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MU — Micron | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Steno's heaviest chip position. Memory benefits from the AI inference build-out and has huge cash flow relative to valuation.

#### Reasoning

Guest Andreas Steno has rotated into stocks with earnings now, as rising rates hurt long-duration names. He prefers memory (Micron, Sandisk) over GPUs because inference will dominate AI budgets. He says Micron has better cash flow than Apple at a fraction of the value, and that the market wrongly prices the chip cycle as ending soon.

#### Sell Triggers

- Mag7 guidance at Q3 reports (e.g. Alphabet on 27 Oct) signals AI capex cuts
- Chip cycle peaks or the data-center capacity spot price falls
- AI spending shifts back to frontier model training instead of inference

> *"Jeg har mere tyngde i hukommelseselskaberne, Micron og Sandisk, end jeg har i Nvidia og AMD."*

---

### 🟢 SNDK — Sandisk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Steno's pick for the stock game to the end of October, and a heavier holding. Chip volumes keep accelerating and the stock is priced for the cycle ending.

#### Reasoning

Guest Steno argues that chip shipment growth keeps accelerating (100-200% a year) while memory stocks are priced as if the cycle ends soon, which makes them look cheap. He picked Sandisk for a short-term bet to the end of October and holds it with more weight than Nvidia and AMD.

#### Sell Triggers

- Chip shipment growth slows
- Mag7 cut AI capex guidance
- Signs the memory cycle has peaked

> *"Sandisk og Bullspeed vil nok være min valg."*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Reports on 27 Oct. A key catalyst for whether Mag7 signal a longer AI cycle than the market expects.

#### Reasoning

Steno sees Alphabet's report as the first test of whether Mag7 management believes the AI capex cycle will last longer than the market thinks. Friis Jørgensen thinks Mag7 may be better placed than chips, given cloud and AI momentum.

#### Sell Triggers

- Capex guidance is cut
- Cloud/AI momentum slows

> *"Alphabet har deres regnskab den 27. oktober her"*

---

### 🟠 DNORD — Norden | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong underlying profit upgrade from higher tanker freight rates. The market is extremely strong while Hormuz disruption persists.

#### Reasoning

Host Michael Friis Jørgensen calls the upgrade strong and driven by underlying operations (freight rates), not trading. With a fixed cost base, every rate increase goes straight to the bottom line. There is no sign of easing in the short term, but investors are already trying to price in Q3.

#### Sell Triggers

- Hormuz situation normalises and tanker rates fall
- Iran deal reduces the risk premium

> *"det var en stærk opjustering"*

---

### ⛔ STZ — Constellation Brands | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell 4.5% after hours on cautious guidance. The rate-sensitive consumer economy is weakening.

#### Reasoning

Friis Jørgensen uses Constellation Brands as a sign that the non-AI, rate-sensitive economy will report fine numbers but give cautious guidance this earnings season. He prefers rate-insensitive tech.

> *"De slog ellers forventningerne, men det var deres guidance."*

---

### 🟠 CEG — Constellation Energy | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up 12.25% on the Meta energy deal. The energy side of AI infrastructure has lagged chips and is a bottleneck.

#### Reasoning

Friis Jørgensen notes that investors bought chips but missed energy as part of the AI infrastructure trade. The Meta deal was a reminder that energy may be as big a bottleneck as chips.

#### Sell Triggers

- AI data-center build-out slows

> *"Mesa gik ud og tegnede en rigtig, rigtig lang aftale på energi"*

---
